comment: Dogbone (mitcad#1011) on the geometry kernel, with analytic volumes. A block 80 x 60 x 20 (Box1, F1, F1.b0) with a pocket 40 x 20, 10 deep, cut by a box from (20, 20, 10) (Box2, F2): its walls F2:side0 (y 20) and F2:side2 (y 40) are 40 long, F2:side1 (x 60) and F2:side3 (x 20) 20 long, its floor F2:bottom; four inside corners 10 long. 96000 - 8000 = 88000.

Dogbone1 (F3) on the body with the defaults: a 6.35 mm tool, 0.1 mm extra, diagonal. Each relief is a circle of r = 3.175 whose centre lies on the corner's bisector a = (r - 0.1) / sqrt(2) inside the pocket on both axes; it removes the circle outside the pocket's quadrant, 2 cap(a) - corner(a) with cap(d) = r^2 acos(d/r) - d sqrt(r^2 - d^2) and corner(a) = r^2 (asin(w/r) - asin(a/r)) / 2 - a (w - a), w = sqrt(r^2 - a^2): 6.388881125 mm2, 10 deep at four corners. The body keeps its id.

Along a side (a T-bone): the relief follows the longer wall (side0 and side2), its centre r off it and 0.1 beyond the corner; it notches the short wall by the circle above its chord 0.1 from the centre, pi r^2 - cap(0.1): 16.469503719 mm2 at four corners.
The tool diameter edited to 8 mm, diagonal again: the same with r = 4, 9.932659413 mm2 at four corners.
The pocket's floor picked: the four corners that end on it, as the body gave them.
A short wall picked (F2:side1), along a side: its two corners, the reliefs along the picked wall notching the long walls, 16.469503719 mm2 each.
Picked corner edges: two of the pocket's, diagonal.
An outside edge of the block and a round edge are refused with the reason; the body stays as it was.
A body without inside corners along the tool axis.

expect.error_contains: no inside corner along the tool axis
